dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth lateral margins with minor localized convexities along the posterior-left boundary where the body meets the water surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity pixel values across the majority of the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple horizontal, parallel dark-contrast linear markings across the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct shadow-casting transverse creases occurring across the central axis of the posterior dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of three to four parallel horizontal linear anomalies on the lower dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior dorsal terminus representing the blowhole.
